status: Analysis of supplied fitted component scores
fold_grid: linspace(min(g), max(g), 101) separately for each draw and panel
evaluation_unit: compound; arithmetic mean of profile scores within compound
pairs: all positive-negative compound pairs, weight one
tie_rule: exact equality of float64 pair differences; no rounding or tolerance in H
scope: Fixed fitted decompositions, observed comparable pairs and magnitude-constrained folded transformations.
grid_interpretation: The grid maximum is a lower bound on the maximum movement over the admissible class; B is its deterministic upper bound.
